```{python}
from nba_api.stats.endpoints import leaguedashplayerclutch

```


```{python}
player_data = leaguedashplayerclutch.LeagueDashPlayerClutch(
    season="2025-26",
    season_type_all_star="Regular Season",
    clutch_time="Last 5 Minutes",
    point_diff=5,
    measure_type_detailed_defense="Base",
    per_mode_detailed="Totals"
)

player_df = player_data.get_data_frames()[0]
```

```{python}
from nba_api.stats.endpoints import leaguedashplayerstats

overall_data = leaguedashplayerstats.LeagueDashPlayerStats(
    season="2025-26",
    season_type_all_star="Regular Season",
    measure_type_detailed_defense="Base",
    per_mode_detailed="Totals"
)

overall_df = overall_data.get_data_frames()[0]

overall_df[["PLAYER_ID", "PLAYER_NAME", "FGM", "FGA", "FG_PCT"]].head()
```

```{python}
overall_df.head()
```

```{python}
df = overall_df[
    ["PLAYER_ID", "PLAYER_NAME", "FGM", "FGA"]
].merge(
    player_df[["PLAYER_ID", "FGM", "FGA"]],
    on="PLAYER_ID",
    how="inner",
    suffixes=("_overall", "_clutch")
)

df.head()
```


Excluding players that arent in both dataframes.
```{python}
df["FGM_nonclutch"] = df["FGM_overall"] - df["FGM_clutch"]
df["FGA_nonclutch"] = df["FGA_overall"] - df["FGA_clutch"]

df = df[
    (df["FGA_clutch"] > 0) &
    (df["FGA_nonclutch"] > 0)
].copy()

df["FG_PCT_clutch"] = df["FGM_clutch"] / df["FGA_clutch"]

df["FG_PCT_nonclutch"] = (
    df["FGM_nonclutch"] / df["FGA_nonclutch"]
)

df["FG_PCT_difference"] = (
    df["FG_PCT_clutch"] - df["FG_PCT_nonclutch"]
)

df[
    [
        "PLAYER_NAME",
        "FGA_clutch",
        "FG_PCT_clutch",
        "FG_PCT_nonclutch",
        "FG_PCT_difference"
    ]
].head()
```

```{python}
df_test = df[df["FGA_clutch"] >= 10].copy()

print(len(df_test))

df_test[
    ["PLAYER_NAME", "FGA_clutch", "FG_PCT_clutch", "FG_PCT_nonclutch"]
].head()
```

```{python}
from scipy import stats

t_stat, p_value = stats.ttest_rel(
    df_test["FG_PCT_clutch"],
    df_test["FG_PCT_nonclutch"]
)

print("Number of players:", len(df_test))
print("t-statistic:", t_stat)
print("p-value:", p_value)
```

We reject the null hypothesis, since the p-value is less than 0.05. The negative t-stat suggests that on average players have a lower FG% in clutch situations.
